summary.intent: Fix a failing vault recovery E2E test in CI by diagnosing the root cause and getting it passing locally before creating a PR.
summary.outcome: Identified and fixed a protobuf field number bug (field 2 vs field 1) in the IPNS record parser, swapped IPNS resolution order to prefer delegated routing over slow IPFS gateway, and resolved two CodeRabbit review comments. PR #369 created and passing locally.

repo: IPNS records use protobuf field 1 for the value/CID path and field 2 for signatureV1 — not the reverse.
In CI, Kubo cannot resolve IPNS names published via mock-ipns-routing, so direct IPFS gateway /ipns/ paths hang for their full timeout before failing.
mock-ipns-routing is a local tool in tools/mock-ipns-routing that must be built and started separately for E2E tests.
The web-e2e Playwright config has a default test timeout that was insufficient for recovery flows involving multiple IPNS resolutions.
Recovery E2E tests require three services: mock-ipns-routing, API (with test config), and web dev server.

code.finding: extractCidFromIpnsRecord() had a stale comment saying 'field number 2' and was checking fieldNumber === 2 when the IPFS path value is actually at protobuf field 1.
CodeRabbit caught that resp.json() consumes the response body, making a subsequent resp.arrayBuffer() call fail — the body can only be read once.
Vault key blob resolution originally tried the slow IPFS gateway /ipns/ path first (30s timeout) before falling back to resolveIpns(). Swapped to try resolveIpns() first.
resolveIpns() tried IPFS gateway HEAD first (15s per call) then delegated routing. In CI this wastes 15s per IPNS resolution. Fixed to try delegated routing first.
Recovery test timeout was increased to 90s to account for multiple network hops in the recovery flow.

workflow: The user's explicit requirement was to get E2E tests passing locally before committing and PR'ing — not to push and rely on CI to validate.
Protobuf field numbers are 1-indexed and must be verified against actual binary output, not assumed from documentation or code comments.
Background services started during debugging need explicit cleanup before committing to avoid polluting the working state.

friction: Multiple rounds of reading recovery.html were needed due to its size — the relevant logic was spread across many sections requiring repeated targeted reads.
Services appeared to still be running after the first test session, causing confusion when running the second test session for review fixes.
The root protobuf field bug was only discoverable by actually inspecting the binary protobuf output at runtime — static code analysis wasn't sufficient.
A pre-existing unrelated change to .planning/config.json had to be explicitly discarded before committing to keep the commit clean.
open_items: CI run on PR #369 not yet confirmed green — test passes locally but CI result was pending at end of session.
The 90s test timeout is a safety margin rather than a precise value — could be tuned down once CI behavior is confirmed stable.
The response body double-read bug (Thread 1 fix) may exist in other fetch call sites in recovery.html — only the one CodeRabbit flagged was fixed.
